reason: A web-profile utility for interactive daily fortune sessions, combining local fortune and Tarot content with optional quotes and Tarot data from external services.

summaries.zh: 为 Web 配置提供包含观音灵签、塔罗牌阵和每日名言的互动今日一签会话页。
summaries.en: A web-profile utility that provides an interactive daily fortune session with Guan Yin lots, Tarot spreads, and daily quotes.

capabilities: Provides a daily fortune interface with Guan Yin lots, Tarot spreads, and daily quotes
Adds a session page, draw button, and settings panel to the web profile
Uses same-origin HTTP for settings and upstream proxy requests
May access zenquotes.io, stoic.tekloon.net, api.adviceslip.com, and tarotapi.dev during user operations
